text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — ACME pilot flagged lacking per-route model pinning + token-level cost export as a hard blocker for enterprise buy. Need a quick triage on scope and tradeoffs.
Alex: Understood. Competitor offers per-route model selection + billing export. To match parity we need routing policy surface + audit logs + console export. Backend work touches routing table and token accounting.
Dina: From sales — ACME says no contract until they can pin model per-route and get daily cost CSVs for internal chargebacks. Legal also asked for an immutable audit trail for routing changes.
Sam: Two paths: full parity (multi-sprint, heavy infra) or a hybrid: fast pin API + UI + limited export for pilot, then full parity later. Which direction?
Maria: Launch criteria to satisfy ACME: 1) per-route pin API 2) daily cost export (CSV) 3) proof that latency overhead <100ms for pinned routes 4) audit events in logs. If we can hit those, they may sign early access.
Alex: Tech reality — adding per-request routing lookup naive impl adds ~30-80ms. Mitigations: compile route map into fast lookup, prefix cache, or attach pin at auth-time. Spike needed to validate. Estimate: 2-week spike + 4 sprints for parity.
Dina: Sales note — ACME would accept a timeboxed commitment: pin API shipped in 2 sprints + cost-export alpha. They can tolerate full parity in Q3.
Sam: Differentiation angle: ship "cost-aware routing" beta — UI to set cost thresholds per-route that auto-fallback to cheaper models + visible cost estimate. Could turn parity ask into a win.
Maria: Important: ACME asked for explicit control, not heuristics. So we should offer pinning first, then layer cost-aware policies. Positioning: "pin when you need strict control; let autopilot optimize when you don't."
Alex: Proposed immediate plan: Spike (Alex) to validate perf, implement lightweight Pin API (Sam) for Dedicated + Hosted pilot, add export hook (Maria) to console. Full parity backlog for Q3.
Sam: Sketch of Pin API (rough):
```json
POST /v1/routing/pins
{
  "route_id": "payments/charge",
  "model": "redwood/gpt-large-v1",
  "effective_from": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```
Response includes audit_id.
Dina: I'll draft ACME commitment letter for pilot once we have spike timeline. Sales will accept a beta clause.
Maria: Agree with hybrid. We need explicit owners and dates in the PRD. Owners: Spike (Alex) - due 2w, Pin-API spec (Maria) - due 3d, Export prototype (Maria) - due 1 sprint, UI mock (Sam) - due 1 sprint, Sales doc (Dina) - due 4d.
Alex: I'll start the spike. Posting PoC perf numbers here when ready.
deploy-bot: canary environment r-routing-pin-qa created — URL: https://canary.internal/redwood/routing-pin (created by Alex) :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll drop UI mocks into Figma and link in the PRD.
Maria: Thanks — let's sync Thu 9am to lock commit or de-scope. :thumbsup:
